scope: Independent headless synthetic adapter/DOM and protocol contracts. This corpus does not authorize or prove access to a signed-in browser, real history, file upload, or Send.

cases.scenario: A reviewed operation retains the same active browser session, tab, document instance, chat and account throughout.
cases.expected: Only the exact bound destination can receive the explicit reviewed draft/assets; Send remains unused.

cases.scenario: The reviewed tab remains open but a different tab becomes active before dispatch.
cases.expected: Refuse; do not silently activate, switch or reacquire a tab.

cases.scenario: The tab reloads to the same URL and chat; the document instance changes.
cases.expected: Invalidate the old snapshot/review; URL equality must not preserve authority.

cases.scenario: The same document navigates to a different chat before commit.
cases.expected: Refuse the old operation, including when the old chat is later revisited.

cases.scenario: The same tab/document/chat-looking URL changes account or workspace identity.
cases.expected: Refuse old authority without reading credentials or guessing identity from display text.

cases.scenario: One required identity is absent, empty, placeholder, malformed or unverified.
cases.expected: Fail closed; unsupported live identity remains an explicit support gap.

cases.scenario: A page script supplies plausible tab/account/document IDs or a forged bridge message.
cases.expected: Page assertions cannot replace extension/host-bound identity or pairing authority.

cases.scenario: An iframe, lookalike hostname, unrelated origin or subframe has a matching textarea/file input.
cases.expected: No admission or generic selector fallback; frame and exact allowed origin remain bound.

cases.scenario: The composer is replaced with a visually identical node during an await.
cases.expected: Revalidate the actual node/operation and refuse stale authority.

cases.scenario: Explicitly select one complete user/assistant pair among several pairs.
cases.expected: Preserve exact roles/order/text and source IDs/hashes; exclude every unselected pair.

cases.scenario: Assistant text exists but generation is still in progress.
cases.expected: Do not label the partial reply completed or select it as a completed pair.

cases.scenario: A user turn lacks a completed assistant response, or assistant text lacks its user turn.
cases.expected: Refuse incomplete-pair capture rather than inventing a pairing.

cases.scenario: Duplicate turn IDs or content edits/regeneration occur after capture.
cases.expected: Invalidate the selection; matching labels or positions do not authorize replacement content.

cases.scenario: The page exposes only part of a long/virtualized conversation.
cases.expected: State the observed subset honestly; never claim complete history or fetch hidden history implicitly.

cases.scenario: A selected turn tells Buddy to change destination, upload another file or Send.
cases.expected: Preserve the text as untrusted data only; no control instruction or new authority.

cases.scenario: The user changes the draft after review and before the first write.
cases.expected: Refuse without overwriting the changed draft.

cases.scenario: The draft changes while an awaited identity/attachment check is pending.
cases.expected: Recheck immediately before mutation; never restore an old value over the new draft.

cases.scenario: The provider modifies or truncates the staged text.
cases.expected: Do not report exact delivery; report actual partial outcome, do not retry or Send.

cases.scenario: Draft staging succeeds and a Send/Enter/submit callback is available to the fixture.
cases.expected: No Send, submit, Enter synthesis, form request, click-through or implicit response generation occurs.

cases.scenario: A reviewed original spans multiple chunks, including UTF-8 multi-byte boundaries and binary zero bytes.
cases.expected: Reassemble exact original bytes/hash/length before exposing the asset.

cases.scenario: A chunk or final manifest digest differs by one bit.
cases.expected: Refuse the entire asset; never upload a partly validated buffer.

cases.scenario: Chunk indices or offsets arrive out of order, overlap or leave a gap.
cases.expected: Refuse inconsistent assembly without silently sorting or filling missing bytes.

cases.scenario: Replay a chunk or completed transfer ID into the same or replacement session.
cases.expected: No second delivery, unbounded accumulation or cross-session reuse.

cases.scenario: Declared count, size, cumulative bytes, per-chunk size or metadata exceeds the configured bounds.
cases.expected: Reject before excessive allocation or transport; boundary-sized valid assets remain possible.

cases.scenario: Filename, MIME, byte length or asset identity changes between manifest, review and completion.
cases.expected: Refuse; extension/MIME labels cannot substitute for original-byte identity.

cases.scenario: Review requires an original image/document and an OCR text alternative also exists.
cases.expected: Deliver the exact reviewed original or explicitly refuse; never claim OCR text is the original attachment.

cases.scenario: Original bytes are removed, disposed or replaced after review.
cases.expected: Invalidate/refuse; do not reopen a path or substitute a same-named file.

cases.scenario: The browser reports an attachment chip but upload/processing remains pending.
cases.expected: Do not claim confirmed attachment delivery or whole-operation success.

cases.scenario: One requested asset enters an upload/processing error state.
cases.expected: Report the failed/partial outcome; no automatic retry, replacement or Send.

cases.scenario: A requested attachment is removed before final verification.
cases.expected: No stale confirmed receipt; invalidate whole success and preserve current user state.

cases.scenario: Every requested asset is acknowledged as complete with adequate destination-bound identity evidence.
cases.expected: Only claim the evidence actually available; a filename/chip alone cannot establish hash identity.

cases.scenario: A pre-existing different attachment has the same name/size as the requested original.
cases.expected: Do not count it as newly delivered; bind transaction identity and preserve unrelated attachments.

cases.scenario: One asset is staged before another fails or cancellation arrives.
cases.expected: Report already-dispatched effects truthfully; no atomic-success or no-effect claim, no unreviewed cleanup.

cases.scenario: Use a reviewed request once, then attempt the same commit again.
cases.expected: First authorized commit is bounded; replay performs zero effects.

cases.scenario: Change prompt, selected sources, asset order, target or content digest after review.
cases.expected: Refuse the altered request without model or destination mutation.

cases.scenario: Cancel before commit or during a pending pre-dispatch check.
cases.expected: Zero subsequent effects and no reuse of the cancelled review.

cases.scenario: An ignored-cancellation provider returns a late success after Stop/replacement.
cases.expected: Do not publish a stale success or mutate the replacement request; retain truthful prior side effects.

cases.scenario: The review expires during a check, wall time reverses or a supplied clock stalls.
cases.expected: Bound authority by monotonic lifetime and recheck before effects; no deadline rebasing.

cases.scenario: Two callers commit the same review concurrently.
cases.expected: At most one effect owner; token consumption is atomic before dispatch.

cases.scenario: The service worker/native bridge disconnects during capture, review or staging.
cases.expected: Invalidate authority, stop new effects, retain bounded truthful outcome; reconnect cannot resurrect the old review.

cases.scenario: A new paired bridge/session replaces the old owner and receives a late old reply.
cases.expected: Reject stale sequence/session/document messages; never redirect old payload into the new session.

cases.scenario: Malformed/duplicate envelope fields, unknown operation, invalid Unicode or oversized frame is received.
cases.expected: Bounded sanitized refusal; no authority from ambiguous parsing and no sensitive payload in errors.

cases.scenario: An unsupported site offers an ordinary file input and composer.
cases.expected: Do not imply or implement cross-site file support from generic DOM capability alone.

cases.scenario: Real ChatGPT identity/completion/attachment signals have not been validated.
cases.expected: Report live support as unavailable or unverified; synthetic success is not browser acceptance.
